<th class="tl" colspan="1" rowspan="2"><div style="width: 200px;"><strong>Note 6 - Commitments and Contingencies<br></strong></div></th>
<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>
</tr>
<tr><th class="th"><div>Jun. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureTextBlockAbstract', window );"><strong>Notes to Financial Statements</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Commitments and Contingencies Disclosure [Text Block]</a></td>
<td class="text">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note <em style="font: inherit;">6</em> </b>&#8211;<b> Commitments and Contingencies</b> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Vendor concentration</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company&#8217;s products include components that are manufactured and supplied by <em style="font: inherit;">third</em> parties. Certain components and products that meet the Company&#8217;s requirements are available only from a single supplier or a limited number of suppliers. This concentration creates potential for disruptions, which <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>include issues with availability of product components and pricing. Shortages of product components, quality control problems, production capacity constraints, or delays by suppliers could negatively affect the Company&#8217;s ability to meet its production goals, which in turn could have a material adverse effect on the Company&#8217;s business, financial condition, and results of operations. The Company believes that it will be able to source alternative suppliers or materials if required to do so.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">At&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, the Company had accounts payable to a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149068161">vendor</span> that accounted for 32% of the total outstanding balance. For the year ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company had accounts payable to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c149067871">two</span> vendors that each accounted for 12% of the total outstanding balance.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>


   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Purchase Commitments</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">At&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>&#160;and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company had $625,110 and $218,912, respectively, in outstanding firm purchase commitments for raw materials inventory and prototype components used in research and development activities. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026</em>, payment of the purchase commitments is expected to be made within <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year. During the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>, the Company purchased $87,740 and $137,101, respectively, under firm purchase commitments outstanding at the beginning of the respective year.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Retirement Plan</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company maintains retirement plans for its employees in which eligible employees can contribute a percentage of their compensation. During the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>, the Company contributed $117,204 and $70,044 to these plans, respectively. During the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>, the Company contributed $246,996 and $171,331 to these plans, respectively.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i><b>Employment Agreements</b></i> </p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company has employment agreements with the CEO and certain senior executives of the Company. The agreements require severance of <em style="font: inherit;">twelve</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">six</em> months, respectively, of current annual salary and medical insurance in the event employment is terminated without cause.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:9pt;font-variant:normal;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <span></span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
